toolArguments.prompt: Create exactly ONE new native complete building game sprite. Compact ONE STOREY street shop, footprint6x5 total3.6 candidate meters. Low flat roof with shallow parapet, short local entry awning. A real recessed door on left of near road-facing facade per guide with handle/solid threshold and limited shallow step; corner display window wraps onto visible left side, blank small sign panel, simple warm brick and timber gray plaster walls. Not B01 clone, no upper floor, no luxury pavilion, no merchandise outside. Reference1 is GEOMETRY ONLY, exact footprint/camera/near-face door location, not proxy colors/lines/text. Reference2 approved TR32 local painterly style ONLY, ignore its old camera/buildings/roads and vegetation. Original supplemental building under approved style, not a source crop replication. Fixed orthographic elevation62.5 azimuth45, frontage u screen -28.486deg, depth n +55.406deg, all vertical walls screen-vertical. Match drawn two base directions, not generic30deg isometric. Japanese daytime urban anime thick-painted style, summarized brush planes, soft upper-left daylight, restrained neutral shading; not photoreal or flat heavy-outline icon. Genuine compact single-storey scale, clearly legible real door. Fully inside frame with safe margin including eaves, base and steps; request1536x1536 true transparent RGBA. ONLY building and necessary small steps, no broad ground slab/patch, lawn, trees, roof trees, people, vehicles, roads, neighboring buildings, sky, text/logos/labels, glowing windows/night light, yellow wash, global blue tint or large baked shadow. Do not use transparency as a doorway or copy guide annotations. No rotate/mirror/shear old sprites.
